label: D. Scarlatti: Fugue in C minor, K. 58
caution: Read by the program from a typeset edition, notes and voices both. The notes were proofread against Gilbert's edition (Heugel) on 2026-11-23 and corrected; the voices are the program's, and two subject entries (bars 7 and 17) are still split between tenor and bass.
title: Domenico Scarlatti: Sonata in C minor, K. 58 (Fuga)

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 20–22).
sections.leads: From C minor to F minor

sections.label: Subject in F minor (Soprano); Subject in C minor, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 14–15), in the same voices, at the same pitch. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Link (bars 32–33).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

sections.label: Together: Subject in C minor, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in C minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: From C minor to G minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor, inverted, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 29; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 31

sections.label: Subject in C minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 20–22) in part, with the bass's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 36–37).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bars 32–33), with the alto's line in the tenor, a step lower. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 2 and a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From C minor to B♭ minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ minor to G minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 48

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 2 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: the opening of countersubject 2.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in F major at bar 52; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 57
